entities.name: Muhammad ibn Ali Rawandi
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Muhammad ibn Ali Rawandi, was a Persian historian who wrote the Rahat al-sudur wa ayat al-surur during the fall of the Great Seljuk Empire and the subsequent invasion by the Kharwarzmian empire.
